verdict.rationale: Omnara documents subagents: an agent can spawn helpers, message them, read their progress, and stop them (omnara-docs-19). It also documents launching agents programmatically via the CLI, REST API, or TypeScript SDK (omnara-docs-2, omnara-docs-14), and running them on connected machines such as laptops or servers (omnara-docs-12). Together these imply multiple agents can run at once, but nothing explicitly documents concurrent execution or fleet-scale parallelism. Missing for 10: explicit docs on running many agents concurrently, concurrency limits or scaling guidance, fleet-level orchestration and monitoring, and independent hands-on corroboration of parallel throughput.
